name: hegefix
description: Claude Code plugins by Viktor Krasnohorskiy.

plugins.name: the-forge
plugins.description: Workflow for parallel Claude Code sessions: one lead session hands tasks to worker sessions, each in its own worktree and tmux session. Skills coordinate-workers (the lead) and work-for-coordinator (each worker), plus merge-train, integration-build, qa-handoff, review-loop, review-round, browser-worker and meeting-prep; launch and close scripts, workspace templates, permission profiles (research, code, device, browser, watcher), optional helper templates (a headless comms watcher that writes digest files, MR watch, janitor, load check, e2e runner, tracker helper, and a headless scribe for teams with an LLM wiki), and an optional module-boundary lint example.
